title: B-tree cursor last-page detection

scope.rationale: cursorOnLastPage determines whether a valid B-tree cursor descended through the rightmost child of every interior ancestor, which is the exact condition for the current leaf to be the table's last page.

external_source_responsibilities: Cursor path construction and valid-state ownership
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete source predicate is assigned; the index-seek caller remains open.

inputs: Valid cursor with paired ancestor pages and selected child indices
outputs: True only when every selected ancestor child is the rightmost child
contracts.ownership: Cursor and ancestor pages are borrowed; no mutation or allocation.
contracts.state_and_results: An empty ancestor path is a last-page path. The first ancestor index below its cell count returns false.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns B-tree serialization; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid cursor state violates the source assertion; valid state has a total boolean result.

representation_differences: The Zig Cursor stores only ancestor pages and indices, so iterating those paired arrays corresponds to C indices 0 through iPage-1.
Page cell count is the length of the owned cells list rather than nCell.

oracle.protocol: Construct a two-ancestor valid path with both indices at the rightmost child, then move one ancestor index left and compare true/false results.
oracle.normalization: Page addresses are identity-only; path indices and counts are exact.

assurance.oom: No allocation in the production predicate.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller lock discipline pending integration.
assurance.malformed_input: Invalid state or mismatched path arrays violate source/model invariants.
assurance.continuation: Pure observation leaves cursor state unchanged.

integration.native_call_path: Typed cursor owner and both predicate branches are unit-traced; index-moveto optimization dispatch remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires index-seek integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.
